head: GPT-Knowledge main
summary: DeepSeek Agent Harness is tracked as an external architecture reference. Brew adopts validated live local-tool reload patterns only; reasoning and policy remain runtime/model authority.

items.title: Existing Brew dynamic-tool foundation
items.detail: Source-owned manifests, validation, containment, registration and cache-busted module imports are already present in Brew.

items.title: Live reload integration
items.detail: Wire and validate watch/reload behavior around the existing Brew local-tool registry without adding a second registry.

items.title: External source
items.detail: Stephen G. Pope — DeepSeek Agent Harness architecture video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hpw4fAHlHDw

items.title: Rejected authority expansion
items.detail: Config files must not become reasoning, approval, safety-policy or execution authority.
